style: Clean modern editorial 3D illustration, soft clay-like rounded shapes, bright airy off-white background (#FAFBFC), main colours violet (#7D29E0) and magenta-pink (#FF01A2) with soft lavender, light grey and white, gentle soft shadows, subtle violet-to-pink glow, friendly and optimistic, plenty of negative space, 16:9 horizontal frame. Generic stylised fictional characters only (no real people, no recognisable faces), no brand names, no logos, no app icons of real companies. Absolutely no text, letters, words, numbers or writing anywhere: screens, papers, forms, sheets and signs show only simple abstract shapes, lines and blocks. Leave clean empty space in the upper part of the frame.

images.prompt: An office worker at a desk buried under a towering pile of identical paper sheets, envelopes and sticky notes, looking tired, while a small friendly glowing violet orb floats beside them offering help. Empty space at the top.

A person sitting between two large monitors manually carrying small identical blocks of data from one screen to the other with their hands, a loop arrow suggesting endless repetition, slightly comic mood.

A neat row of rounded violet and pink domino-like blocks falling one after another in a chain reaction, the first one tipped by a small glowing spark, ending in a tidy finished stack. Sense of automatic motion.

A friendly fork in a road splitting into three clean paths leading to three different abstract buildings: one cloud-shaped, one a cube-shaped workshop, one a tall modular tower; a small traveller with a backpack thinking at the crossroads.

Split composition: on the left a soft violet cloud holding a small glowing machine of connected blocks; on the right a cosy small house with an open door showing a compact server rack running the same machine of connected blocks inside.

Four big rounded starting buttons on a light surface, each with a simple symbol: an alarm clock, an envelope arriving, a doorbell, a pointing hand clicking. From each button a glowing line starts to travel to the right.

A clean assembly line of rounded machine modules connected by glowing violet cables; small boxes travel along the conveyor and each module transforms them (sorting, painting pink, stamping a check mark). Isometric view.

Isometric view of a conveyor belt carrying a row of identical small transparent boxes, each containing the same set of three coloured abstract cards; a magnifying glass hovers over one opened box revealing its cards. No writing on the cards.

A large friendly key ring holding several rounded keys of different colours, each key connected by a thin glowing line to an abstract generic app tile (plain rounded squares with simple geometric shapes, no logos) floating around it; a small padlock shield in the centre.

Left to right flow: a floating web form card with empty abstract fields, a glowing arrow, a spreadsheet grid filling with new coloured rows, another glowing arrow, and a bell ringing with a small notification bubble. Clean diagram-like illustration.

A chain of connected rounded blocks on a light surface; one block in the middle glows red with a small warning triangle while a friendly character with a big magnifying glass inspects it and holds a small wrench. Other blocks glow green.

A hand flipping a large rounded toggle switch from off to on; behind it a tidy machine of connected blocks lights up in violet and pink and starts working by itself, with a small calendar and clock floating nearby.

A large clean marketing funnel: many small contact cards (abstract silhouettes and lines, no faces, no text) drop in from the top, get sorted and come out at the bottom into a neat filing cabinet drawer; a small celebratory sparkle.

An overflowing mailbox on the left; a friendly robotic arm sorts envelopes into three coloured trays (violet, pink, grey) and places a short summary card (abstract lines only) on top of each tray. Calm, organised mood.

A friendly glowing violet-to-pink orb character with simple cute eyes floats in the centre, surrounded by small floating tools it can use: a calendar, an envelope, a spreadsheet grid, a magnifying glass, a chat bubble, each linked to it by a soft glowing line.

A bright modern library wall of shelves holding rolled blueprints and small ready-made machines of connected blocks; a person picks one blueprint off the shelf and unrolls it showing a simple diagram of connected nodes (shapes only).

A tidy workbench with a machine of connected blocks; each block has a small blank coloured label tag hanging from it, a sticky note attached to the side (blank), and a small shield with a lock protecting a key box. Everything neat and organised.

A relaxed person sitting comfortably with a cup of coffee looking out of a big window at sunrise, while behind them on the desk a small machine of connected glowing violet and pink blocks quietly works on its own. Warm, satisfied mood.
